literal.prompt: Какой автомобиль Mercedes-Benz называет первым в истории автомобилестроения?

literalGroups.primaryGround: Mercedes-Benz caption L292 and section L294/L301 identify the Benz Patent Motor Car as the first automobile. Its contemporaneous Daimler motor carriage is separately captioned L324; Victoria is identified as the first Benz with double-pivot steering in 1893 and Velo as the first production car in 1894 (L316/L322). These are four plausible early automobile models, but only the Benz Patent Motor Car receives the asked first-automobile attribution.

literalGroups.literal: Mercedes-Benz называет первым автомобилем Benz Patent Motor Car. 29 января 1886 года Карл Бенц подал заявку на патент № 37435 на автомобиль с бензиновым двигателем; в июле газеты сообщили о первой публичной поездке этой трёхколёсной модели.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The manufacturer labels the Benz Patent Motor Car the first automobile (L292-L303). L297 specifies a gasoline-powered car and L298 describes the completed 1885 vehicle; L303 gives Carl Benz’s 29 January 1886 application, patent number 37435, and the July public outing of the three-wheeled model.

literalGroups.literal: 29 января 1886 года Карл Бенц подал заявку на патент № 37435 на автомобиль с бензиновым двигателем.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The same page calls the project a car powered by a gasoline engine (L297) and says Carl Benz applied for patent number 37435 on 29 January 1886 for his historically named “vehicle powered by a gas engine” (L303). The note translates the fuel consistently with the surrounding context and identifies this as a patent application.

literalGroups.literal: Подпись к фотографии связывает моторный экипаж 1886 года с Готлибом Даймлером и его сыном Адольфом.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The page caption identifies Gottlieb Daimler and his son Adolf on the motor car (motor carriage) in 1886 (L324).

literalGroups.literal: Victoria стала первым Benz с двухшарнирным рулевым управлением, запатентованным Карлом Бенцем в 1893 году.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The page states that Carl Benz patented double-pivot steering in 1893 and that the Victoria was the first Benz to use it that year (L316; image caption L318-L320).

literalGroups.literal: Mercedes-Benz называет Velo первым серийным автомобилем; всего построили около 1200 экземпляров.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The page calls the Benz Velo of 1894 the world’s first production car and gives approximately 1,200 units built (L316/L322).
